text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy wants to stand out in her 
debut race. To boost interest in dirt 
racing itself, she plans to produce a 
promotional video.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the advice of friends who race on dirt, 
she wonders if she could make her 
promotional video an official academy 
video, and heads to the student council 
room to negotiate—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Student Council officers were away. 
But just then, Biko Pegasus, an aspiring 
hero of justice, showed up and suspected 
an evil plot was afoot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though they understood it was a 
misunderstanding, they couldn't overlook 
someone aiming to be a bad girl. Shinko 
Windy rejoices at the attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A race showdown with Biko Pegasus might 
happen someday.
